item.title: Key Dates and Venue for the 2026 Premier Kitchen & Bath Event
item.description:
Upcoming Industry Gathering in Orlando
#

The Kitchen & Bath Industry Show (KBIS) stands as a leading event for professionals in kitchen and bath design. The 2026 edition will bring together industry experts, manufacturers, and innovators to showcase the latest trends and products.

item.title: Upcoming Industry Event: KBIS 2026 Announcement
item.description:
Insights into BYSON’s Upcoming Event Participation
#

BYSON INTERNATIONAL CO., LTD. is excited to announce its involvement in the upcoming KBIS 2026, recognized as the premier kitchen and bath design event. This participation underscores BYSON’s commitment to innovation and excellence in the industry, offering a platform to showcase the latest advancements and solutions for kitchen and bathroom design.
